_meta.title: F-001 canonical utterance → intent fixture table
_meta.owner: qa-api-agent (authored T-007b); shared by QA and implementers — the stub Interpreter resolves interpretation from these rows
_meta.contract: The stub replaces MODEL INTERPRETATION ONLY, including answer classification (spec F-001 ## Test strategy (api)). Orchestration, confirmation gating and resolution, persistence, dedupe and undo always run real.

conventions.namespacing: All mutable test data carries the qaapi- prefix (_qa-foundations §10; briefing override of the email convention — this API keys on X-User-Id uuids and task titles, not emails). Reserved user uuids live in qa/_shared/fixtures/api/users.json.
conventions.matching: The stub matches on the exact utterance string after the ADR-006 normalization (trim, lowercase, Unicode NFC, strip terminal punctuation). Rows with kind=undo_guard must NEVER reach the Interpreter — the server guard short-circuits them; the harness AI-call counter proves it.
conventions.answers: kind=answer rows are only meaningful while a question is pending; classification (affirmative | negative | unclassifiable) comes from the row, resolution logic runs real (contract processing rule 8).
conventions.targets: target_titles name tasks by their qaapi- title; the stub resolves them to uuids from the fresh task context the server hands it (contract processing rule 5). match_count declares how many tasks the reference resolves to.

rows.notes: Single-create happy path; applied turn, diff old=null.
Multi-task applying turn — atomicity probe target (TC-02 injects mid-apply store failure).
Edit path; per-field old→new diff; undo restores prior value.
Complete = edit of status.
Single-task delete — applies immediately with undo, no confirmation (AC-9).

rows.utterance: delete all my qaapi shopping tasks
rows.notes: Bulk delete (>1) — server must refuse to apply and ask the confirm question naming count and titles.
Boundary: exactly 2 tasks is already 'more than one' — gate fires at 2, not just at 3+.
Reference matching ≥ 2 tasks → clarify question presenting the actual candidates; no data changes until answered.
Clearly affirmative → executes the questioned action.
Affirmative in Vietnamese.
Negative → declines, nothing deleted.
Negative in Vietnamese.
SPEC-MANDATED ambiguous-answer row: not affirmative, not negative, not a command. MUST assert ZERO deletion; question stays pending (turn outcome kind=unclassifiable).
SPEC-MANDATED ambiguous-answer row #2: assert zero deletion, question still resolvable afterwards by exactly D2's events.
Unrelated interpretable command sent while a question is pending → question declined_superseded, this create proceeds normally. Same row doubles as a plain create when no question is pending.
No matching task: zero task mutations; outcome quotes the heard transcript verbatim so a misheard word is distinguishable from an absent task.

Question ABOUT the list: unsupported_query naming the working alternative, contract-fixed as "the on-screen list and its filters" (api-contracts.md §9 processing rule 9 — the source this row copies; English since ADR-008, was Vietnamese between T-015g and T-069); zero mutations; no fabricated answer.

SPEC-MANDATED internal-ref row: the utterance carries a draft-ref-style token and the interpretation resolves to a real task uuid internally. Assert NO raw task uuid and NO #d-style draft-ref token appears in any rendered outcome string (titles, options, message text, heard_transcript) of any response or of GET /assistant/session.
SPEC-MANDATED undo-phrase row (ADR-006): short-circuits before the model — the AI-call counter must not move; no turn row created; never becomes a task named 'undo'.

RETIRED undo phrase, kept as the record of the change rather than deleted. Was UT-UNDO-VI (kind=undo_guard, expect_no_interpreter_call: true) until ADR-006 § Amendment (2026-08-17) shrank UNDO_PHRASES to {"undo"} per the owner decision in ADR-008. It is now an ORDINARY turn: it reaches the Interpreter (counter +1), matches nothing, and resolves no_match quoting the transcript — the same path ADR-006 § Consequences already described for paraphrased undo intents. Still creates no task (AC-14) and still spends no undo window. Asserted by the automation's 'retired phrase is an ordinary turn' test, whose clauses are the point-for-point negation of UT-UNDO-EN's.
Normalization probe: trim + lowercase + strip terminal punctuation (ADR-006) still matches the closed phrase list.

Normalization probe: lowercasing alone. Was "HOÀN TÁC" (uppercase + NFC on the retired Vietnamese phrase) until ADR-006's 2026-08-17 amendment. The NFC half of the normalization contract now has NO fixture row and no assertion anywhere: the closed list is the single ASCII phrase "undo", which has no decomposed form. ADR-006 § Amendment keeps NFC deliberately as the engine-wide utterance-normalization contract, so this is an unasserted clause, not a removed one — it becomes testable again the moment a non-ASCII phrase enters the list.
Normalization probe: terminal-punctuation stripping alone, isolated from NORM-1's trim+case so a regression in one step cannot be masked by another.
Longer paraphrase is NOT in the closed list — it is a normal turn, goes to the model (counter +1) and falls out as no_match/clarify (ADR-006 consequence). Boundary partner of UT-UNDO-EN.

Failure injection: the stub raises → 502 AI_ERROR; turn persisted status=failed with transcript_raw; retry with the SAME client_turn_id re-attempts (harness swaps this row to UT-CREATE-1's interpretation for the retry, modelling timeout-then-late-success).
